scoreInterpretation: Comparative evidence under the same five frozen visible outcomes, not a universal numeric approval threshold.

observations.finding: The leaning broad crown, varied shoulder height, lower body and differently sized front stones form one coherent cobalt bank. Irregular angled contours and softly finished edges improve the old repeated straight-sided pillar construction. N/W retain broad planes but no longer finish as nearly black rectangular fronts. The native closed nesting reads consistently in N/E/S/W and at logical/phone scale.

Cobalt remains the dominant family, with lighter blue upper planes and readable blue lower midtones. The original lower navy dead zones are relieved without copying the target white-cyan seam lattice. In both320px-phone contexts and fractional-pan landscape contexts, the yellow submarine remains the color focal point and the creature silhouette remains legible; the bank reads as blue scenery.

Broad restrained blue crown/shoulder lighting and small edge rolloffs describe the native volumes. Highlights remain colored, without clipped white glare, bloom, external halo or a preferred horizontal key. Small rounded stones add softer highlight transitions beside the main angular planes. One unchanged centered/equal-cardinal/ambient recipe serves all facings; no directional ground shadow is visible.

Large stone planes, varied secondary contours and sparse shallow dimples give restrained material character. Dimples are small or disappear at phone scale while the mass hierarchy still reads. This satisfies the quiet background role without random noise, mandatory target cracks or a dense decoration lattice.

All4 native/published views, neutral logical/64px-cell studies, repeated3x3 all4 and all12 actual browser screenshots were inspected fully. No material black patch, broken normal, coplanar flicker pattern, exposed/open bottom, clipped form, detached stone, accidental transparency or halo was found. Narrow under-crown crevices read as intentional stone nesting. Repeated layouts are treated as density/silhouette studies, with no modular seam condition.

remainingDifferences: The main crown retains broad angular planes and a visible lower ledge rather than the target's many subdivided softened boulder faces; it remains coherent and readable at game size.
Surface detail is much sparser than the generated target, and the cyan-white edge network is omitted. The restraint supports the frozen quiet scenery role.
Some small dimples become invisible on phone. Their disappearance does not carry the silhouette or stone hierarchy.
